tooltips.sessionsLeft: Lessons still to book: bought, minus booked (Planned), minus done (Held). A lesson set to Not Held gives its session back.
tooltips.sessionsHeld: Lessons in this package marked Held. Mark a no-show Held if it should use up a lesson.
tooltips.sessionsBooked: Lessons in this package still Planned.
tooltips.sessions: How many lessons they paid for. Change it to add or take away lessons.
